svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Hub: steel tube 70 mm OD, 80 mm long, bored 30 mm with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: an 8 mm keyway; M8 grub screw over the key.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Web: 6 mm plate disc 370 mm across, welded to the hub

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at its middle, square to the bore.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rim: cut two sidewalls from a used car tyre, the bead

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ring trimmed off, 470 mm outside diameter.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bolt them either side of the web rim with 12 M8 bolts

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on a 420 mm circle; the two inner faces lean together

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to form a V that grips the rope at a 400 mm circle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Width over the rubber 90 mm; groove 4 mm wide at the root.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: spin it on the shaft; the V runs true within

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 mm; a 6 mm rope sits in it without bottoming.
